help: Help with your account and signing in

errors.passwordTooShort: The password needs at least 12 characters.
errors.passwordTooLong: The password can have at most 128 characters.
errors.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, for example name@example.ch.
errors.nameTooShort: The name needs at least 2 characters.
errors.nameTooLong: The name can have at most 80 characters.
errors.organizationNameRequired: Enter the name of the organisation, at least 2 characters.
errors.organizationNameTooLong: The name of the organisation can have at most 120 characters.
errors.ageRequired: Confirm that you are at least 18 years old.
errors.termsRequired: Accept the terms and the privacy policy.
errors.codeInvalid: Enter the 6 digits from your authenticator app.
errors.codeWrong: This code is not correct. Codes from the app change every 30 seconds.
errors.backupCodeWrong: This backup code is not correct or has already been used.
errors.invalid: This entry is not correct. Check it and try again.

form.summaryTitle: {count, plural, one {One entry is missing or not correct} other {# entries are missing or not correct}}

rateLimited.title: Too many attempts
rateLimited.seconds: {seconds, plural, one {Wait # second, then try again. Your entries are kept.} other {Wait # seconds, then try again. Your entries are kept.}}
rateLimited.minutes: {minutes, plural, one {Wait # minute, then try again. Your entries are kept.} other {Wait # minutes, then try again. Your entries are kept.}}

network.title: No connection to the server
network.body: Your entries are still here. Check your internet connection and send the form again.

unexpected.title: That did not work
unexpected.body: Your entries are still here. Try again in a moment.

register.title: Create account
register.intro: Choose how you use the platform. After signing up, you confirm your email address.

member.label: Member
member.description: You look for providers, save favourites and write messages.

provider.label: Provider
provider.description: You offer services yourself and set up a profile that only becomes visible after review.

club.label: Club
club.description: You run a club with a venue and link the profiles of the providers there.

agency.label: Agency
agency.description: You represent several providers and manage their profiles together with them.

name.label: Name
name.hint: This is how we address you. You can change it later.

email.label: Email address
email.hint: We send the confirmation link here.

password.label: Password
password.hint: At least 12 characters. A sentence of several words is easy to remember.

register.ageConfirmed: I am at least 18 years old.
register.termsAccepted: I accept the <terms>terms</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
register.termsNewTab: The links open in a new tab, your entries stay here.

closed.title: Sign-up is closed at the moment
closed.description: We cannot send confirmation emails right now, and without confirmation no account is created. Try again later.

inbox.title: Check your inbox
inbox.withEmail: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to activate your account.
inbox.withoutEmail: We sent you a confirmation link. Open it to activate your account.
inbox.expiry: The link is valid for 24 hours. If you cannot find the email, look in your spam folder.

verified.title: Email confirmed
verified.provider: Your account is active. Next, you set up your provider profile. It stays private until it has been reviewed and approved.
verified.member: Your account is active. In the member area you find messages, favourites and settings.
verified.visitor: Your account is active. Sign in to continue.

invalid.title: This confirmation link is no longer valid
invalid.body: The link has expired or has already been used. Enter your email address and we will send you a new one.

sent.title: The email is on its way
sent.body: If there is an unconfirmed account for this address, a new link arrives within a few minutes.

invalid.title: Email address or password is not correct
invalid.body: Check your entries. If you no longer know your password, you can set a new one.

unverified.title: Confirm your email address first
unverified.body: You can sign in once it is confirmed. Open the link in the email we sent you.

passkeyFailed.title: Signing in with a passkey did not work
passkeyFailed.body: It was cancelled, or this device does not know a passkey for your account. Try again or sign in with email and password.

totp.intro: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
totp.label: Code from the app

backup.intro: Enter one of the backup codes you saved during setup. Each code works once.
backup.label: Backup code
backup.switch: Use the code from the app

trustDevice.label: Trust this device for 30 days
trustDevice.hint: Only on a device that you alone use. For 30 days we will not ask for the code here.

expired.title: Your sign-in has expired
expired.body: For security reasons this step is only valid for a short time. Sign in again with your email address and password.

locked.title: Too many wrong codes
locked.body: Signing in is temporarily blocked. Wait a few minutes, then sign in again.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter the email address of your account. We send you a link to set a new password.

sent.title: Check your inbox
sent.body: If an account exists for this address, an email with a link is on its way. The link is valid for 1 hour.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.intro: Choose a password that you do not use anywhere else.

devices.title: All devices will be signed out
devices.body: With the new password, all existing sessions end. Afterwards you sign in again everywhere.

invalid.title: This link is no longer valid
invalid.body: The link has expired or has already been used. Request a new one, it will be valid for 1 hour.

done.title: Password changed
done.body: All devices have been signed out. Sign in with the new password.
